SELECT m.id, m.mobile, m.username, m.password, m.register_ip, m.assets as balance, m.freeze_balance as freezeBalance, m.charge_sum as chargeSum, m.withdraw_sum as withdrawSum, m.history_investment as historyInvestment, m.history_profit as historyProfit, m.commission_balance as commissionBalance, m.tgrs, m.historywithdrawcnt, m.historychargecnt, m.invite_code as inviteCode, m.upinvite_code as upinviteCode, (SELECT tbb.mobile from tb_user tbb where tbb.invite_code=m.upinvite_code) as superiorName, m.agent, agent_user.username as agentName, m.salesmanid, salesman_user.username as salesmanName, m.channel as extensionName, m.tz_withdraw_status, m.equipment, m.last_date, m.last_ip, m.today_recharge AS todayRecharge, m.today_withdraw as todayWithdraw, m.today_profit, m.sy_sum, m.history_ua_profit, m.history_ub_profit, m.history_uc_profit, m.ua_profit, m.ub_profit, m.uc_profit, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_investment_record ir WHERE ir.user_id = m.id ), 0) as historyInvestment, m.biaoqian, m.vip, m.uacnt, m.cashwithdrawable, m.ubcnt, m.uccnt, m.status, m.withdraw_count as withdrawCount, m.withdraw_quota as withdrawQuota, m.withdraw_sum, m.superior_code as superiorCode, m.invite_code_status as inviteCodeStatus, m.reward_withdraw_status as rewardWithdrawStatus, m.create_date as createDate, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_investment_record ir WHERE ir.user_id = m.id AND DATE(ir.order_date) = CURDATE() ), 0) as todayInvestment FROM tb_user m LEFT JOIN sys_user agent_user ON m.agent = agent_user.id LEFT JOIN sys_user salesman_user ON m.salesmanid = salesman_user.id
AND m.agent = #{params.currentUserId}
AND m.salesmanid = #{params.currentUserId}
AND m.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.mobile}, '%')
AND m.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.username}, '%')
AND m.invite_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.inviteCode}, '%')
AND m.channel = #{params.channel}
AND m.biaoqian = #{params.biaoqian}
AND m.vip = #{params.vip}
AND m.assets > 0
AND m.assets = 0
AND m.biaoqian IS NOT NULL AND m.biaoqian != ''
AND (m.biaoqian IS NULL OR m.biaoqian = '')
AND m.charge_sum > 0
AND m.charge_sum = 0
AND m.history_investment > 0
AND m.history_investment = 0
AND m.withdraw_sum > 0
AND m.withdraw_sum = 0
AND m.superior_name IS NOT NULL AND m.superior_name != ''
AND (m.superior_name IS NULL OR m.superior_name = '')
AND m.create_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND m.create_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
ORDER BY
m.create_date m.update_date m.mobile m.username m.assets m.charge_sum m.withdraw_sum m.history_investment m.history_profit m.commission_balance m.vip m.agent m.salesmanid m.create_date
ASC DESC
m.create_date DESC

SELECT m.mobile, m.agent, agent_user.username AS agentName, m.biaoqian, m.salesmanid, salesman_user.username AS salesmanName, m.charge_sum AS investmentAmount, m.invite_code_status AS inviteCodeStatus, m.commission_balance AS rewardBalance, m.history_commission AS totalReward, m.uacnt AS xjzhCnt, -- 一级佣金统计（返佣A - 业务类型3） COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(ubd.use_amount) FROM user_balance_detail ubd WHERE ubd.user_id = m.id AND ubd.busi_type = 3 AND ubd.status = 1
AND ubd.transaction_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND ubd.transaction_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
), 0) AS oneReward, -- 二级佣金统计（返佣B - 业务类型30） COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(ubd.use_amount) FROM user_balance_detail ubd WHERE ubd.user_id = m.id AND ubd.busi_type = 30 AND ubd.status = 1
AND ubd.transaction_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND ubd.transaction_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
), 0) AS twoReward, -- 三级佣金统计（项目返上级 - 业务类型32） COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(ubd.use_amount) FROM user_balance_detail ubd WHERE ubd.user_id = m.id AND ubd.busi_type = 32 AND ubd.status = 1
AND ubd.transaction_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND ubd.transaction_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
), 0) AS threeReward, -- 其他奖励字段（暂时使用默认值） m.withdraw_quota AS ytReward, 0 AS zztReward, 0 AS cce3fl, 0 AS fxfl, -- 工资统计（业务类型12） COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(ubd.use_amount) FROM user_balance_detail ubd WHERE ubd.user_id = m.id AND ubd.busi_type = 12 AND ubd.status = 1
AND ubd.transaction_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND ubd.transaction_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
), 0) AS gz, -- 注册奖励统计（业务类型27） COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(ubd.use_amount) FROM user_balance_detail ubd WHERE ubd.user_id = m.id AND ubd.busi_type = 27 AND ubd.status = 1
AND ubd.transaction_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND ubd.transaction_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
), 0) AS zcfl
FROM tb_user m LEFT JOIN sys_user agent_user ON m.agent = agent_user.id LEFT JOIN sys_user salesman_user ON m.salesmanid = salesman_user.id
AND m.agent = #{params.currentUserId}
AND m.salesmanid = #{params.currentUserId}
AND m.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.mobile}, '%')
AND m.invite_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{params.inviteCode}, '%')
AND m.channel = #{params.channel}
AND m.biaoqian = #{params.biaoqian}

AND m.commission_balance = 0

AND (m.biaoqian IS NULL OR m.biaoqian = '')
AND m.withdraw_quota > 0
AND m.withdraw_quota = 0
AND m.superior_name IS NOT NULL AND m.superior_name != ''
AND (m.superior_name IS NULL OR m.superior_name = '')
AND m.uacnt > 0
AND m.uacnt = 0
AND m.create_date >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.startTime}/1000)
AND m.create_date <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{params.endTime}/1000)
AND m.agent = #{params.agent}
AND m.salesmanid = #{params.salesmanid}

SELECT u.mobile, 0 as level, COALESCE(ir.tzcnt, 0) as tzcnt, COALESCE(ir.tzamount, '0') as tzamount, COALESCE(wo.withdrawamt, '0') as withdrawamt, COALESCE(u.assets, 0) as balance, u.biaoqian, u.invite_code_status as inviteCodeStatus FROM tb_user u LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) as tzcnt, CAST(SUM(investment_amount) AS CHAR) as tzamount FROM tb_investment_record WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY user_id ) ir ON u.id = ir.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, CAST(SUM(real_amount) AS CHAR) as withdrawamt FROM tb_withdraw_order WHERE state IN (1, 2) GROUP BY user_id ) wo ON u.id = wo.user_id WHERE u.mobile = #{mobile} ORDER BY u.create_date DESC
